reuse.why: All rule changes go through the existing isMonthFillTarget/getMonthFillCategories selection, and the new last-month action reuses getMonthFillCategories, getSheetValue and spendingToBudgetAmount.

duplication.why: The new goal_def/group-note columns and notes join are added to both getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories SQL, a small parallel edit in two pre-existing queries, but the rule itself is defined once.

placement.why: Selection rules live in actions.ts beside the existing fill-target helper and the new action is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Changes are limited to month-wide actions, their selection helper, handler registration, tests and a release note; the now-unused 'all' scope is removed as part of the hidden fix.

maintainability.why: Clear named predicates (hasSavedTemplates, isFixedCostGroup) inside one selection function; the includeHiddenCategories short-circuit also silently overrides the 'visible' scope's no-group exclusion, which is slightly implicit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending and copyPreviousMonth, decides through isMonthFillTarget.

disguised_duplication.where: Only the SQL column/join additions are repeated across the two existing queries, openly.

abstraction_drift.where: isMonthFillTarget and getMonthFillCategories each gain the includeHiddenCategories parameter, and isMonthFillTarget gains an early-return branch for it; template and #fixed checks are general rule clauses, and no call site bypasses the helper.
